title: Fourmula PageSpec
description: A generated page: one of the 5 closed templates, one of the 6 closed routes, and an ordered list of section instances, with a REQUIRED closed mode (clone | generation). There is no free-form token or style override: the only styling field is the optional, closed node-level styleTokens, which takes semantic token REFERENCES only (TOKEN_* rules); styling is otherwise owned by the section and component contracts. The non-standard keywords maxWords and maxWordsTotal are annotations enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py, where a word count is always len(text.split()). Media use only local absolute paths and the closed assetRole enum from assets/asset-roles.json; remote, protocol-relative and '..' paths are rejected by pattern. EVERY length in the underlying token system is a rem on a FLUID root font-size - see tokens/00-foundation/typography.json before converting anything to px. Generated from the section contracts by extraction/build_pagespec_schema.py.

mode.description: REQUIRED and closed. clone = a faithful reconstruction of the source; real source copy and clone-only assets may be reused for fidelity. generation = a NEW page for someone else: schema/semantic_validate.py's GENERATION_MODE_* rules reject the source brand, assets, people, customers, product imagery, copy, claims, hosts and embeds, and only generation-safe asset roles are admitted.

theme.description: Optional; defaults to registry.manifest.json defaultTheme. Validated against styleTokens by TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH. NOTE the source's inverted class names: the light palette is selected by .body.dark.

nodes.description: Computed from templates/templates.json: the smallest real template needs 5 nodes, the largest (legal, with 16 chapters) 22.

assetRole.description: Closed enum from assets/asset-roles.json. One member (auth-inert-form) describes a behaviour slot, not a file.

motion.description: CLOSED to the only fields a real section contract carries per instance: pattern (const-locked per section type by the allOf branches below) and reducedMotionFallback. The contracts' detailed reveal/marquee/trigger descriptions are owned by the section contract and are never restated per instance. additionalProperties is false on purpose: leaving it open would let a generated PageSpec smuggle in an invented motion field and still validate.

reducedMotionFallback.description: REQUIRED on every node. For every section except the background-video slot this is a DESIGN RULE prescribed by this repository, not mirrored behaviour: public/motion/m27.js is the only script in the whole project that reads prefers-reduced-motion, and no stylesheet contains a prefers-reduced-motion rule.

reducedMotionFallbackKind.description: Which of the two the fallback is for this node. Only the background-video slot can honestly claim `mirrored`.

retrievalEligible.description: Optional echo of the section contract's retrievalEligible. RETRIEVAL_PIN rejects true on pinned runtime UI and false on a content section.

styleTokens.description: Optional, closed set of token REFERENCES (never values). Each value must be a semantic role id from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json for that slot; raw colours, raw lengths, unknown ids, unsupported fonts and other-palette ids are rejected by the TOKEN_* rules in schema/semantic_validate.py.

oneOf.title: onboarding-cta
oneOf.description: The /start stand-in. COMPOSED, NOT MEASURED - there was no source page to transcribe. Its word budgets are the lengths of this project's OWN composed copy, not measurements of fourmula.ai.

oneOf.title: auth-form
oneOf.description: The /auth stand-in. COMPOSED, NOT MEASURED. It carries the project's single <form>, which is DELIBERATELY INERT and is pinned to the auth-inert-form asset role.
